name: Frost
desc: Ice creeps in from the edges of the frame — dendrites nucleate on the border and branch inward at the real 60-degree ice angle, the growth front breathing deeper and shallower while seeded facets ignite as it sweeps over them; steer the cold pole with x/y and the frame slowly glazes over from that side.

energy.doc: how deep the frost front reaches in from the edges + facet sparkle

density.doc: nucleation sites / branchiness / facet count (rebuilds the sheet)

scale.doc: crystal + band size vs design size

alpha.doc: overlay opacity — drop toward 0.2 to sit politely over a busy scene

hue.doc: ice hue (195 cyan-white, 30 sodium rime, 280 violet cold)

x.doc: cold pole X — edges nearest it frost deepest

y.doc: cold pole Y — edges nearest it frost deepest

style.doc: aesthetic: feathered windowpane bloom / coarse needle spicules / white-on-dark stipple engraving, no glow / thermal false-colour by branch depth

act.doc: dramaturgy: slow breathing advance / surges with the musical arc and sublimates back / marches deep and holds, only the tips shiver
